_comment: Copy to .deploy.json and fill in the two deployment ids from `npx clasp list-deployments`.
.deploy.json is gitignored: this repo is public, and the app door's URL is the whole
of what stops a stranger reaching the page in the first place.
`access` is not a setting this file applies — it is the assertion the deploy script
checks the live door against afterwards. ANYONE_ANONYMOUS is 'Anyone', MYSELF is
'Only myself'. The bank door has to be Anyone: Enable Banking redirects the consent
flow to it with nobody signed in. The app door serves balances and must be MYSELF.
lastDeploy is written by the script and is how it knows which files changed since.
Delete it to force the next run to treat everything as changed.
